data.camera: cowboy shot, resting one hand on pedestrian overpass railing
data.description: 【御坂美琴 · 学园都市天桥】夕阳斜照在学园都市空旷的高架天桥上，微风吹拂着常盘台的校服裙摆与茶色短发。美琴单手扶着栏杆俯瞰着下方疾驰而过的单轨列车，指尖跃动着微弱的蓝白色电火花——「今天也被风纪委员和黑子唠叨了一整天……不过像这样站在天桥上吹吹风，总算能稍微喘口气了。」
data.promptProse: Misaka Mikoto rests one hand on the pedestrian-overpass rail, watching Academy City tracks and traffic below as faint blue sparks cross her fingertips. White blouse, light-brown vest and beige pleated skirt move in the evening wind beneath a spirited smirk. The cowboy view includes turbines and high-tech towers beyond the rail. Orange sunset lights their facing glass and her hair edge; city reflections soften the rail's shaded underside around the small sparks.
data.title: 御坂美琴 · 学园都市天桥
